text:
maria: Kicking off canary for v3.2.1 (embedder + router) in the 18:00-20:00 UTC change window. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/3.2.1

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: service=embedder image=redwood/embedder:v3.2.1 traffic=10% region=eu-west replicas=2

kevin: Watching SLO dashboard (p95, 5xx, cache-hit). Baseline p95=~180ms, keep me posted. @jen can you stand by? :eyes:

jen: Checking dashboard -> https://redwood.ops/slo/embedder?range=15m  small p95 bump to 260ms in eu-west, tail not sustained. 5xx still low.

maria: Good catch. Quick agreement: rollback if p95 > 300ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.5% for 2m. Also watch kv-cache hit rate. Agreed?

kevin: +1. Also flag if cache-hit drops >10% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: health-check: pods_ready=2/2, readiness=ok, traffic_shift=10%

jen: Seeing a tiny 5xx blip (0.2%) correlated to an edge node. Logs show timeouts hitting kv lookup path. Snippet:

```
embedder-1 | ERROR TimeoutError: kvlookup timed out after 150ms
  at lookup (/srv/cache.py:88)
  at handler (/srv/worker.py:203)
```

maria: Hmm. That could explain tail. Can we pause the canary in eu-west (set to 0%) and pin route to v3.2.0 while we investigate?

deploy-bot: Traffic shift requested: region=eu-west target_canary=0% -> initiating rollback to stable:v3.2.0

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: service=embedder region=eu-west now serving stable:v3.2.0; route pin applied: emb-eu-west -> v3.2.0

kevin: SLOs recovering — p95 back to ~190ms, 5xx ~0.03%. Looks stable after rollback.

jen: I'll open a follow-up: INF-3421 to investigate kv cache timeouts / hot-shard behavior and add flamegraphs + heap dumps. Ticket: https://jira.internal/INF-3421

maria: Next steps: re-run canary tomorrow with adjusted cache timeout and a warm preload (8% warm traffic) and stronger circuit breaker for kv lookup. Update release notes to reflect the pause and rollback.

kevin: Adding release note draft: "Canary paused due to kv lookup timeouts in EU; rolled back to v3.2.0 for embedder. Follow-up INF-3421."

deploy-bot: Deploy event closed: status=aborted canary reason="kv timeout spike" notifier=release-team

maria: Thanks all. Filed follow-up, moving this to post-mortem channel later. :thumbsup:
